full_judgment: 7. Mr. M. A. Matin, learned Advocate appearing for plaintiff-respondent Nos. 1-12, submits on the other hand that a right of way also includes such ancillary right as the right to use the sub-soil. He relies upon sections 3(4)(a) and 44(1) of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, Gale on Easements, 13th Edition, page 39, Halsbury's Laws of England, Vol. 14 (4th Edition) page 7 and the cases of Judoo Lall Mullick vs. Gopal Chunder Mookerjee, 13 I.A. 77 and 1877 L.R. (5) 133 in support of his submission.
